core_job: For plane spotters watching one airport: pick the airport and see, live, every aircraft around it sorted by what it is doing (approaching, departing, overflying, on the ground), nearest first. Tap one for its live altitude, speed, climb rate, operator, ICAO24 and flown track. Data comes from one anonymous OpenSky /states/all bounding-box call (curl 2026-10-12: HTTP 200, 161 states round KSFO). Travel planning is out of scope and links out to TripNest.
signature: Approach Scope plus Spotter Log. The Scope is a range-ringed radar view painted offline and centred on the airport, with phase-coloured blips. It feeds an 'Inbound now' list of aircraft the on-device classifier judges to be approaching (descending, below 3,000 m, track within ±35° of the bearing to the airport), showing distance, altitude, speed and '≈ N min out at current speed'. That figure is labelled as a straight-line estimate, not an ETA. Evidence it fills with real content: in the saved 2026-10-12 21:44Z KSFO snapshot, a simple offline filter found 17 aircraft descending below 4,000 m within 60 km. The full classifier has not been run yet. The Spotter Log saves each sighting on the device from the live state, with search and filter by airport and date, and 'Copy as CSV'. Competitors (Flightradar24, FlightAware, Plane Finder) are NOT verified: web search was unavailable in this session.

must_fix: OpenSky's anonymous /flights/departure and /flights/arrival requests are limited by a UTC-midnight cutoff, not by 20 h. Curl at 12:04Z: begin=midnight+60s returned 200 and begin=midnight-60s returned 403 'You cannot access historical flights'. 16, 19 and 20 h windows all returned 403. Fix: clamp `begin` to max(now - window, start of the current UTC day) in OpenSkyDataSource.airportBoard and route search, and show honest copy when the effective window is shorter than the one chosen (e.g. 'since 00:00 UTC'). Then decide whether the SFO–LHR/JFK–LAX route chips stay, because route search finds nothing early in the UTC day. Replace the ≤72000 s test (flight_data_source_contract_test.dart:270-314) with one that injects a clock at, for example, 05:00Z and asserts begin ≥ 00:00Z that day.
Remove the "AeroSwift" row from /Users/spatchava/agl/agl-manifest/scripts/generate_app_icons.py:60 (M4 MUST), so a generator re-run cannot overwrite the hand-drawn icon.
